locations.name: Bowling Green
locations.factShort: Bowling Green is a small historic public park in the Financial District of Lower Manhattan in New York City, at the southern end of Broadway.

locations.name: Plumb Beach
locations.factShort: Plumb Beach (sometimes spelled "Plum") is a beach and surrounding neighborhood along the north shore of Rockaway Inlet, in the New York City borough of Brooklyn. It is located near the neighborhoods of Sheepshead Bay and Gerritsen Beach, just off the Belt Parkway.

locations.name: Queensbridge Park
locations.factShort: Queensbridge Houses, also known simply as Queensbridge or QB, is a public housing development in the Long Island City neighborhood of Queens, New York City.

locations.name: The Schomburg Center
locations.factShort: The Schomburg Center for Research in Black Culture is a research library of the New York Public Library and an archive repository for information on people of African descent worldwide.

locations.name: The Longwood Historic District
locations.factShort: The Longwood Historic District is a recognized historic district located in the center of the Longwood neighborhood in the South Bronx, New York. It encompasses about three square blocks roughly bounded by Beck Street, Longwood, Leggett, and Prospect Avenues.
